svg.title: LUMEN gallery floor plan
svg.desc: A loop corridor around a central atrium, with five vaulted galleries opening off its outer face and sculpture niches in the corridor wall.
svg.text: the only daylight · you are given the lamp here
Five vaulted galleries open off the outer face of a loop
corridor that returns you to where you began.
Your lamp is the only light in it. Sculpture sits in four
recessed niches, lit only as you pass.
Crossing a threshold fades up that room's vault slot over
two seconds, washing the ceiling. Step back out and it
Gallery Three is the far room.
Largest, furthest from the entrance, and the one that
Hang position for a framed work
Vault crown, the light slot above
Suggested route · the tour camera path
Five rooms · one atrium · 41 × 36 m · 1 unit = 1 metre
